name: Workplane.toSvg
signature: Workplane.toSvg(self, opts: Any = None) -> str
doc: Returns svg text that represents the first item on the stack.

name: Workplane.transformed
signature: Workplane.transformed(self: ~T, rotate: Tuple[float, float] | Tuple[float, float, float] | cadquery.occ_impl.geom.Vector = (0, 0, 0), offset: Tuple[float, float] | Tuple[float, float, float] | cadquery.occ_impl.geom.Vector = (0, 0, 0)) -> ~T
doc:
Create a new workplane based on the current one.
The origin of the new plane is located at the existing origin+offset vector, where offset is
given in coordinates local to the current plane
The new plane is rotated through the angles specified by the components of the rotation
vector.

name: Workplane.translate
signature: Workplane.translate(self: ~T, vec: Tuple[float, float] | Tuple[float, float, float] | cadquery.occ_impl.geom.Vector) -> ~T
doc: Returns a copy of all of the items on the stack moved by the specified translation vector.

name: Workplane.twistExtrude
signature: Workplane.twistExtrude(self: ~T, distance: float, angleDegrees: float, combine: bool | Literal['cut', 'a', 's'] = True, clean: bool = True) -> ~T
doc:
Extrudes a wire in the direction normal to the plane, but also twists by the specified
angle over the length of the extrusion. NOTE: twistExtrude(distance: float, angleDegrees: float) — positional args only; there is no `twistAngle` keyword.

name: Workplane.union
signature: Workplane.union(self: ~T, toUnion: ForwardRef('Workplane') | cadquery.occ_impl.shapes.Solid | cadquery.occ_impl.shapes.Compound | None = None, clean: bool = True, glue: bool = False, tol: float | None = None) -> ~T
doc:
Unions all of the items on the stack of toUnion with the current solid.
If there is no current solid, the items in toUnion are unioned together.

doc:
Select the vertices of objects on the stack, optionally filtering the selection. If there

name: Workplane.wires

name: Wire.makeHelix
signature: cq.Wire.makeHelix(pitch: float, height: float, radius: float, center=Vector(0,0,0), dir=Vector(0,0,1), angle=360.0, lefthand=False) -> Wire
doc: Create a helical wire. Sweep a profile along it with Workplane.sweep(path, isFrenet=True). The profile must lie on a plane whose normal matches the helix start tangent (+X at angle 0), e.g. cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(radius, 0, 0)).
